description: CORRECTED: Test data for verifyAndStoreVaccination function - health_care_provider_id should NOT be included
fix_applied: Removed health_care_provider_id from request - it's retrieved from verification record
explanation: The verifyAndStoreVaccination function should get the health_care_provider_id from the verification record that was created during storeWithVerification, not from the request payload.

what_was_fixed: Changed the code to use $verification->health_care_provider_id instead
This gets the healthcare provider ID from the verification record
The verification record was created during storeWithVerification and contains the correct healthcare provider ID
workflow_reminder: 2. This creates a verification record with the healthcare provider ID
